headlines: Atlantic allies convene emergency talks as regional security conditions deteriorate rapidly overnight
Global markets sharply reassess central bank interest-rate outlook after inflation surprise data
Berlin accelerates critical transit corridor repairs after engineers discover additional structural wear
European regulators tighten critical cloud infrastructure security and resilience requirements significantly today
summaries: Atlantic allies opened emergency security talks after a rapid deterioration in regional conditions raised immediate concerns. Officials said discussions would address civilian protection, diplomatic channels, coordinated contingency planning, and practical measures to prevent further escalation, while warning that negotiations remained at an early and uncertain stage and that additional decisions could follow as verified information emerged over the coming hours.

Global markets shifted sharply as investors weighed fresh inflation data against cautious guidance from major central banks. Government bond yields moved higher across several regions, while analysts said figures reduced expectations for rapid interest-rate cuts and increased uncertainty about borrowing costs significantly through this year.

Berlin transport officials accelerated repairs on a heavily used rail corridor after engineers discovered additional structural wear during inspections. Revised operating plans add replacement buses, extend evening construction shifts, and redirect passenger flows to reduce disruption while crews work toward restoring reliable service across network.

European regulators issued strengthened security requirements for cloud services supporting energy, transport, healthcare, and other critical sectors. Providers must improve incident reporting, supply-chain controls, access safeguards, and resilience testing under a phased timetable intended to reduce systemic infrastructure risks and improve cross-border response coordination substantially.
